text: The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates to interview for appointment to the Board of Directors of TO Live. Following the interviews, the Civic Appointments Committee will recommend three candidates, including a Chair, for appointment to City Council.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Referred item 2026.CA33.3 back to the City Clerk and directed the City Clerk to conduct further outreach for the appointment of public members to the Board of Directors of TO Live, to fill the remaining vacancies. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b, and 2 to the report (February 18, 2026) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Board of Directors of TO Live.
